open_points.subject: issue_contract_version
open_points.text:
- issue_contract_version: [VALIDATION_ERROR] The release ceilings are the imported RELEASE_CEILING_WALL_TIME_MS, RELEASE_CEILING_MEMORY_BYTES, RELEASE_CEILING_OUTPUT_BYTES and RELEASE_CEILING_PROCESS_COUNT constants for the fields of the same name; a bound above its ceiling or omitted is refused, never clamped or defaulted; every check after the purpose rule binds only a new version: contract_version_id is computed right after the purpose rule, and an existing equal contract version is returned unchanged even when a later release lowered a ceiling below its bounds (A01 rule 4, A20 rule 4).
- issue_contract_version: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] contract_version_id is content_identity of the ContractVersionContent; an existing equal contract version is returned unchanged with slot None and nothing is written, so it does not become the slot's current version again; otherwise one IssueContractVersionChange is written through record_change with issued_at from kernel_now, the given actor and created_slot_purpose set only when the slot is new.
open_points.other_text:
- ResourceBounds fields (exact, no others exist): wall_time_ms: int, memory_bytes: int, output_bytes: int, process_count: int
- ResourceBoundsRequest fields (exact, no others exist): wall_time_ms: int | None, memory_bytes: int | None, output_bytes: int | None, process_count: int | None
open_points.question: Must omitted or otherwise invalid requested bounds be rejected before computing contract_version_id, or must ContractVersionContent accept ResourceBoundsRequest values such as None so the ID can be computed immediately after the purpose rule?
